appearances.name: Knights of Guinevere · Hommage · Guinevere
appearances.identity: Clothing-only homage to Guinevere: small golden crown between the eyes; a royal-blue headpiece with two round side buns carrying pale lavender four-point stars, fitted BEHIND the huge unobstructed frog eyes. Pale lavender puff sleeves, a light periwinkle/lavender princess dress with white pointed center panel, golden waist tabs and narrow gold edging. The split skirt ends above ankles and shows Ribbit's long green legs and bare three-toed webbed feet; golden ankle bands. Ribbit's pink bow at neckline, green four-fingered hands. No jester horns, human hair, bells, mechanical body or skin recoloring. The costume evokes the second reference while Ribbit stays a tall thin frog.

appearances.name: Knights of Guinevere · Résident · Réparateur des automates
appearances.identity: Original amusement-park automaton maintenance worker, retaining Ribbit's natural lime frog body and long thin limbs. Cream work cap between/behind the eyes, brass goggles resting on its top; short slate-blue work jacket with rolled cream cuffs, cream shirt open over belly, pink bow tie, navy knee-length overalls with brass fasteners, small brown utility belt with one winding key and cream pouch, tidy slate-blue ankle cuffs with bare frog toes. A small amber indicator on cap is solid glass, not a glowing effect. This is practical park-worker clothing, not princess dress and not robot anatomy. Adapt second-reference costume materials without copying Pomni's jester cap, bells, red/blue body or face.

appearances.name: Knights of Guinevere · Fusion · Automate des bassins
appearances.identity: A genuinely redesigned frog-shaped amusement-park automaton. Ribbit's recognizable two immense white eyes and wedge pupils sit in round lime enamel housings above an elegant lime porcelain frog face with pink cheek discs and wide smile. The body is built from cream and mint porcelain shell segments with royal-blue floral motifs, exposed brass ring joints at elbows/knees, dark inner mechanical links; slim curved arms, sturdy elongated spring-jointed frog legs and broad articulated three-toed paddle feet. Small wind-up key mounted behind torso, a cream oval belly hatch bordered brass, pink bow-shaped enamel collar. The two spring coils inside rear-leg joints are structural; no detached pieces. Rounded blue shoulder shells and tasteful brass trim. Reimagine the anatomy as one coherent frog machine, not a frog wearing armor. No human face, jester cap, bells or knight sword. Entire key and all toes in frame.
